request: 当前除了start的脚本外，所有的bat都闪一下就没，然后不工作，目录中仍然有ps1的脚本存在
acceptance: All standard BAT entrypoints execute native commands with visible action/result and preserved exit code; double-click retains diagnostics, automation can disable pause.
Git build/clean rebuild current native host even with an existing stale EXE; start never compiles.
Legacy PowerShell moves out of active entry/runtime directories into explicit test fixtures; package and native source identity exclude retired scripts.
Run actual Windows cmd wrappers with compiled native executable for source/release, missing/stale EXE, failure/success, Unicode/spaces paths and bootstrap boundary; preserve user data.
scope: Windows BAT dispatcher/bootstrap and native lifecycle dispatch
Archived legacy Windows test fixture paths, source inventory and packaging

requirements.summary: User confirmed Git source checkout. Preserve original dirty aide/start.command, runtime 9999 and persistent data; do not publish or deploy.

design.summary: Shared CMD entrypoint owns interactive result lifetime. Explicit build/clean bootstraps fresh native host and stops only owned controller before replacing bootstrap EXE; normal actions validate launcher contract. Keep legacy PowerShell only as archived regression fixtures.
